selection_rationale: Mechanism round on the same 48 compact mothers as the direction round (smallest-seed rule, outcome-blind, identity-bound). Controlled interface-resource rearrangement arms: every arm permutes an existing resource value multiset on a fixed node set, so total resource, the value distribution and the pre-substep boundary-cooperator mean are exactly unchanged; only which node holds which value differs. interface_protect pairs the largest boundary values with the largest linear sensitivity w_u, interface_harm the reverse, interface_shuffle a frozen random permutation, and defector_shuffle the same permutation logic on defector nodes whose own resources never enter payoffs (exactly zero predicted linear response). Primary pre-registered test (see preregistered_mechanism_predictions.json, written before these runs): the mother-level paired contrast q_B(interface_harm) - q_B(interface_protect) is positive with a mother-level cluster bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero.
interpretation: finite-horizon fate endpoints for controlled interface-resource rearrangements at fixed total, distribution and boundary mean; local-allocation mechanism test, no infinite-time claims
